spec.assertion: One buffApply per ally (count === unit count, distinct targetSlugs, includes viper) with stat atkPct=25.98 / hitRatePct=11.13. Fails under the nearest-wrong self-only or enemy-scoped encoding (1 event / null targetSlug), and under a casterAtkPct flat-resolved encoding.

expiresFrame <= 11*60 on every application, plus a counterfactual that sets durationSec 9999: team total rises >0.1%. Fails under a permanent-aura model (no/huge expiry, and the counterfactual would be inert).
Same event + duration shape as the ATK line; the joint removal counterfactual drops EVERY teammate's total, proving the ally target set is live rather than decorative.

buffApply stat sustainedDamagePct value 4.4, targetSlug === 'viper', maxStacks === 10, observed stacks peak exactly 10; raising maxStacks to 100 raises viper's total. Fails under an ally-scoped model, under a pre-multiplied single 44% buff (no maxStacks/stacks), and under an uncapped model (the cap counterfactual would be inert).
buffApply stat hitRatePct value 1.84, self-targeted, maxStacks 10 — filtered by value so the skill2 21.96% continuous hit-rate buff cannot be mistaken for it.

Event-order: the first 4.4% apply comes AFTER the first fullBurstStart, while shots exist before it (non-vacuity). And at least one apply occurs between the first fullBurstEnd and the next fullBurstStart. Fails under both nearest-wrongs — ungated-from-t=0 (stacks before FB) and fbGate 'inFb' (no stacks between windows).

x10 the buff: viper gains with the DoT present, but is byte-identical to the DoT-less run when the DoT is removed. Fails if the line is encoded as attackDamagePct/trueDamagePct (a generic Damage Up would still move her normal attacks).

Self-targeted hitRatePct 21.96 with no expiry inside the 180 s fight; removing it lowers viper's total (hit-rate core lift) and leaves every teammate byte-identical. Fails under a 10-sec-window or ally-scoped encoding.
it.skip — defensive, no targeting/HP model in v1. Its only damage-relevant consequence (Vamp acquired at first Full Burst entry, then held for the fight) is tested as the skill1 stack gate.

Structural: exactly one reenterStage effect, stage 2, on a block whose trigger.kind is 'burstCast'. Behavioural: base burstCast count >= 2 and strictly greater than the reenterStage-removed run. Fails under fullBurstEnter keying (over-fires on any team Full Burst) or a burstEligibility encoding.

One flatDamage atkPct 1029.6; removing it lowers viper's total (also the non-vacuity proof that she casts); adding noFb changes nothing, proving it resolves at cast and never took the +50% Full-Burst major. Fails if modelled at Full-Burst entry.

buffApply with casterIdx === null AND targetIdx === null, stat defPct, value 19.83, and zero ally-targeted events at that value; emptying the burst slot lowers EVERY teammate's total. Fails under a self/ally-scoped DEF encoding or an inert one.

Exactly one dot effect, atkPct 105.3, durationSec 10, intervalSec 1, flavor 'sustained'; removing it lowers viper, stretching it to 30 s raises her. Fails under a per-shot repeating DoT trigger (would multiply instances), a non-sustained flavor (would break the skill1 stack-scope test), or a free-floating duration.

fixtures: controlComp('viper', true) for every run — liter (B1) + crown (B2) + viper (Burst II) + helm (B3). The fixed B3 slot is mandatory: viper is Burst II, so without a B3 the chain never reaches stage 3, no Full Burst ever starts, and the entire Vamp-gated half of her kit (skill1 block 2) would be vacuous. The fixture's second Burst II (crown) is also what makes 'Re-enters Burst Stage 2' observable as an extra burstCast. 14 hoisted 180 s runs: base + 13 withPatchedOverride counterfactuals (team window off / made permanent, Vamp stacks off / uncapped, skill2 hit rate off, reenterStage off, burst slot emptied, flatDamage off / forced noFb, DoT off / stretched to 30 s, sustained buff x10 with and without the DoT). Every counterfactual records how many effects its mutation actually hit and asserts that count > 0, so a no-op patch can never masquerade as a passing test. Counterfactual predicates match on VALUE (25.98 / 11.13 / 4.4 / 1.84 / 21.96) rather than stat name so the deltas survive an alternative-but-faithful stat encoding; the buffApply assertions police the encoding itself.
gaps: skill2 'Vamp: Prevents being targeted by single-target attacks continuously' — no targeting model and the v1 boss deals no damage (it.skip).

skill2 'This effect is removed upon taking a direct hit' — no incoming-damage model, so Vamp is held for the whole fight once acquired; this is what makes the skill1 stack gate a simple first-Full-Burst threshold (it.skip).
skill2 'Invulnerable for 1 sec' — defensive, no HP pool (it.skip).
burst 'Affects 1 designated enemy unit(s)' — v1 has exactly one enemy, so single-target scoping is unobservable (it.skip).
burst 'Affects the enemy if the enemy is the stage target' — the scope-lock boss IS the stage target, so the condition can never be falsified in this fixture (it.skip).

NOT a gap but flagged: the Vamp gate needs no self-status primitive — a resource pool (initial 0, +1 on fullBurstEnter, shot-trigger resourceGate min 1) expresses 'dead before the first Full Burst, live continuously afterwards' exactly. If the shipped model instead uses fbGate 'inFb' or leaves the stacks ungated, the two ordering tests in the skill1-B2 group are the discriminators.
